metadata.title: COSU Facilities Control Terminal SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining Corporate-Owned Single-Use (COSU) Facilities Control Terminals as constrained endpoint execution environments for building and facilities operations.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: A corporate-owned, single-use endpoint dedicated to the monitoring and operation of facilities systems such as HVAC, lighting, energy management, and building automation, with tightly constrained execution and network scope.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: COSU Facilities Control Terminals inherit foundational endpoint trust governance from the Secure Endpoint Platform SSPP.

props.name: endpoint-class
props.remarks: Single-use COSU endpoint for facilities and building systems control.

props.name: execution-model
props.remarks: Execution is restricted to approved building management, facilities control, and monitoring applications.

props.name: user-authentication-model
props.remarks: Authorized facilities operators authenticate by role; no general-purpose user profiles are permitted.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: Facilities Control Terminals are owned by the institution.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: Facilities Control Terminals are centrally enrolled, configured, monitored, and recovered.

props.name: cryptographic-identity
props.remarks: Device identity is used for network trust, system integrity, and command authorization with facilities platforms.

props.name: baseline-hardening
props.remarks: Operating system configuration disables general productivity software, removable media, web browsing, and unauthorized interfaces.

props.name: operator-scope-restriction
props.remarks: Operator actions are constrained to predefined facilities control scopes and logged for accountability.

props.name: network-access-model
props.remarks: Network access is restricted to building automation networks, facilities management platforms, time-series monitoring systems, and management endpoints.

props.name: data-persistence
props.remarks: Local data persistence is limited to transient operational state and encrypted logs required for troubleshooting.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: Facilities Control Terminals may interact only with operational and non-sensitive institutional data.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: Facilities operational control authority does not imply eligibility for IT administrative, data, or endpoint trust escalation.

props.name: availability-requirement
props.remarks: Facilities Control Terminals must prioritize uptime and rapid recovery to support safe and continuous building operations.

props.name: monitoring-and-integrity-signals
props.remarks: Device health, command activity, configuration drift, and tamper events are continuously monitored.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: Facilities Control Terminals support auditable provisioning, change management, reset, and retirement workflows.

system-implementation.remarks: COSU Facilities Control Terminals implement Secure Endpoint patterns with emphasis on operational integrity, restricted execution scope, and safety-critical availability.

roles.title: Facilities Operations
roles.remarks: Responsible for operation, monitoring, and response using Facilities Control Terminals.

roles.title: Facilities Governance Authority
roles.remarks: Approves control scopes, safety constraints, and change management for facilities systems.

roles.title: Endpoint Security Operations
roles.remarks: Ensures security posture, monitoring, and lifecycle governance for Facilities Control Terminals.

control-implementation.remarks: Facilities Control Terminal implementations may use hardened workstations, industrial HMIs, or embedded control consoles and are maintained as controlled configuration baselines aligned with this SSPP.
